name: CopyCat Blocker
author: Huzaifa Al Mesbah

sections.description:
CopyCat Blocker is a powerful WordPress plugin that helps protect your website content from unauthorized copying. When visitors try to copy text from your website, the plugin replaces the copied content with your custom message or emojis, effectively preventing plagiarism and content theft.

Designed for bloggers, content creators, and business owners who want to safeguard their valuable content, this lightweight plugin offers an easy way to implement copy protection without affecting user experience or SEO.

How to Use

Setting Up Copy Protection:
1. After activation, navigate to Settings > CopyCat Blocker in your WordPress admin panel
2. Enable protection using the intuitive toggle switch
3. Enter your custom replacement text using the rich text editor (supports HTML and emojis)
4. Save your settings
5. Test by copying content from your website – you’ll see your custom message instead of the original content

Key Features

  • Easy Activation – Simple toggle switch to enable/disable content protection
  • Custom Replacement Text – Set personalized messages to appear when content is copied
  • Rich Text Editor – Format your replacement text with HTML
  • Emoji Support – Add emojis to your replacement text for eye-catching messages
  • SEO Friendly – No impact on search engine optimization or page indexing
  • Performance Optimized – Lightweight code with minimal impact on page loading speeds
  • User-Friendly Interface – Clean, intuitive settings page
  • Universal Protection – Works across your entire website
  • Customizable Messaging – Create different messages for different purposes
  • Zero Configuration – Works immediately after activation with default settings
  • Modern Design – Sleek, contemporary user interface

Use Cases

  • Blog Protection – Prevent plagiarism of blog posts and articles
  • Product Descriptions – Protect unique product descriptions from competitor copying
  • Educational Content – Safeguard educational materials and courses
  • Creative Writing – Protect stories, poems, and other creative works
  • Legal Documents – Prevent unauthorized copying of terms of service or legal content
  • Research Publications – Protect original research and findings
  • Marketing Copy – Guard your carefully crafted marketing messages
  • Website Content – Secure all text content across your entire website

Pro Tip

Create a replacement message that includes your website URL or copyright information. This way, if someone does try to copy your content, they’ll also be copying your attribution information.

Check out our other Plugins

Enhance your WordPress site with our other powerful plugins:

  • Smart Password Protect – Secure your WordPress site with password protection and IP whitelisting.
  • Redirect After Logout – Redirect users to a custom page after logging out for enhanced user experience.
  • Access Defender – Advanced security plugin to protect your WordPress site from unauthorized access and malicious attacks.
  • Contributors Gallery – Showcase your WordPress contributors in a beautiful and customizable gallery layout.
  • Quick ID Viewer – Quickly view and copy post, page, and taxonomy term IDs directly from your WordPress admin panel.

Support

For support queries, feature requests, and bug reports, please use the WordPress.org support forums.

For priority support and custom development inquiries, please contact us through our website.

Privacy Policy

CopyCat Blocker does not collect, store, or share any personal data. It operates entirely within your WordPress website.
sections.installation:
Via WordPress Repository (Recommended):

  1. Log in to your WordPress Dashboard
  2. Navigate to Plugins > Add New
  3. Search for “CopyCat Blocker”
  4. Click “Install Now” and wait for the installation to complete
  5. Click “Activate” to enable the plugin
  6. Go to Settings > CopyCat Blocker to configure your protection settings

Manual Installation:

  1. Download the plugin zip file
  2. Log in to your WordPress Dashboard
  3. Navigate to Plugins > Add New > Upload Plugin
  4. Choose the downloaded zip file and click “Install Now”
  5. After installation, click “Activate”
  6. Go to Settings > CopyCat Blocker to configure your protection settings
sections.faq:
Does this plugin affect SEO?

No, the plugin doesn’t modify your actual content or affect how search engines see your website. It only affects the client-side copy operation, so search engines will still index your content normally.

Can I use HTML in the replacement text?

Yes, the plugin includes a rich text editor that allows you to format your replacement text with HTML. You can add headers, paragraphs, links, and other HTML elements to create a professional-looking message.

Will this prevent screenshots?

No, this plugin only prevents text copying. It cannot prevent screenshots or other forms of content capture. For comprehensive content protection, consider combining this with other security measures.

Can I disable protection on certain pages?

Currently, the protection applies site-wide when enabled. Page-specific controls may be added in future updates based on user feedback.

Is this plugin compatible with page builders?

Yes, CopyCat Blocker works with all major page builders including Elementor, Divi, Beaver Builder, and Gutenberg. The protection applies to the final rendered page regardless of how it was built.

How does the plugin work?

The plugin uses JavaScript to intercept the copy action in visitors’ browsers. When someone tries to copy content, the plugin replaces the selected text with your custom message in their clipboard.

Will this affect my website performance?

No, CopyCat Blocker is designed to be lightweight and optimized. It loads minimal resources and has negligible impact on your website’s loading speed.

Can visitors disable this protection?

Advanced users with technical knowledge might be able to work around the protection. However, CopyCat Blocker effectively deters casual copying and makes content theft more difficult for most visitors.

Does this work on mobile devices?

Yes, the protection works on all devices including smartphones and tablets, as long as they support JavaScript.

Can I change the replacement text anytime?

Yes, you can update your replacement text anytime by visiting the Settings > CopyCat Blocker page in your WordPress admin panel.
